[Mythic] Totem of the Storm now has Intellect and can be found in the intellect option of the Mythic+ loot cache.

Fixed an issue where the Thunderclap from the tier 2.5 set (which damage is based off of thunderclap) would have an underflow in its scaling when used with the Thunderstruck Mystic Enchantment, causing it to deal far more damage than intended.
Fixed an issue where PvP Progression 4 Ranged Weapons have been reverted to their old damage. Their correct DPS is now 59.7.

You can no longer use invisibility potions while affected by crows rage from the crows cache. Additionally, gaining the effect of crows rage (being near the crows cache) or attempting to loot crows cache will remove invisibility & invisibility potions. These changes mainly address an exploit where players would be able to use an invisibility potion then log out and wait for the crows to spawn.

[Requires Launcher Update] Slows are no longer displayed by default in the Lose Control popup UI. 
You can enable them, or toggle other Crowd Control effects in [Esc > Interface > Lose Control]
[Requires Launcher Update] You can now view your current Personal Rating in 2v2 and 3v3 by hovering over the Rated 2v2 or 3v3 arena buttons in the PvP UI.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed the Character Advancement toggle buttons constantly flashing. They now only flash when you have talent essence to spend.

Potion of experience duration will now stack, you can consume multiple potions to increase the duration. If you reach max level you will receive these potions back for every 60+ minutes of duration you have remaining.
Vanity items in your collection will now automatically be learned when you make a new character.
Vanity items retrieved  from your collection will now automatically be learned.
Felforged heroes can no longer post Aura and Potion of experience to the felforged auctionhouse since these items are not usable by felforged heroes.
Potion of Experience now warns you when there is only 1 minute duration remaining.
Added experience reward to some Path to Ascension quests that were missing it.
Removed items from Battleground and Dungeon caches that required any reputations or skills.
Green drops from Battleground caches will now be based on the primary stat you select.
When you learn a profession you will now automatically receive the tools needed for the profession.
Personal Banks can now be used in start zones regardless of rested status.
[Requires Launcher Update] Moved the position of the current item on the Mystic Enchanting UI to be closer to the reforge and extract buttons.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where in rare cases your Rated Arena Rating displayed in the Rated PvP UI was incorrect.

1.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue where the Celestial Focus capstone would trigger even when you were casting.
[Pending restart] Living Bomb now explodes when the target dies.
Healing Wave now heals for 15% less while in a 2v2 arena, 3v3 arena or in a battleground, changed from 10%.
[Area 52] Fixed an issue where old ranks of Hammer of Justice were still usable (they are disabled now and will be removed from your spellbook on next server restart).

7.description:
These two changes to Mana-Fiend will go live on January 20th, 2022 and are posted early so you can be prepared when they go live. 

Mana Fiend now increases your intellect by 15% from 25%.

The mana-drain from Mana Fiend Delirium will now increase by 5% per stack of Delirium.
[Pending restart] Ice Lash now deals 20% increased damage vs monsters.
[Pending restart] Frost Bomb now also explodes when the target dies.
Fixed an issue where Fan of Knives could be used in some scenarios while the Soul of The Warden mystic enchantment was not active.

5.description: Postponed changes to Shattrath Flask effect potencies.
Corrected an issue where Shattrath Flasks could be stacked with regular Flasks and Elixirs.
Corrected an issue where Shattrath Flask of Restoration would apply its Healing Bonus effect twice.

Corrected an issue where Shattrath Flask would visually be removed from the players buff bar when using another flask or leaving a raid but in keeping its bonus stats, making it possible to use all flask effects together and use them outside listed TBC raids.

Shattrath Flask of Fortification, Shattrath Flask of Restoration, Shattrath Flask of Supreme Power, Shattrath Flask of Relentless Assault, Shattrath Flask of Pure Death, Shattrath Flask of Blinding Light can now also be used inside Karazhan, Gruuls Lair, Magtheridons Lair and ZulAman. Tooltipps will reflect that with a later spell patch and now state to be active in Outland Raids.

Reduced the effects of Shattrath Flask of Fortification, Shattrath Flask of Restoration, Shattrath Flask of Supreme Power, Shattrath Flask of Relentless Assault, Shattrath Flask of Pure Death, Shattrath Flask of Blinding Light by 25%. This ensures the crafted alchemy counterparts are still the most valuable Flask to use in a raiding enviroment.

Shattrath Flask of Fortification, Shattrath Flask of Restoration, Shattrath Flask of Supreme Power, Shattrath Flask of Relentless Assault, Shattrath Flask of Pure Death, Shattrath Flask of Blinding Light now have a 1 copper sell price and can be vendored.
Mark of the Illidari now have a 1 copper sell price and can be vendored.
Dragonbreath Chili is no longer classified as a poison and can no longer be cleansed.

6.description: [Serpentshrine Cavern] All trash creatures inside Serpentshrine Cavern will now drop Mark of the Illidari.
[Tempest Keep] Corrected multiple issues where creatures would have a to high chance for Mark of Illidari to be dropped.

0.description: Fixed an issue where Vem could sometimes not drop loot.
Aura of Experience will now persist through death, so you gain experience modifiers for any kills that happen while dead.
You can now gain exp and kill credit while dead.
[High-Risk] HR Forges and HR Warded Tablets will no longer incorrectly appear on the mini-map when using track herbs.
[High-Risk] Hidden Caches and Beast Nests will now appear as treasure on the mini-map.
Fixed an issue where the Enhancement Shaman t5 set was scaling far too high with spellpower than intended. It now has the correct AP coefficient of 5.75% & SP Coefficient of 9%.

7.description: Mystic Enchantments that would spread auras or cast a single target spell at multiple surrounding targets now ignore checks for whether the caster was facing the target or not. In the case of spreading auras, the caster was technically the target, causing spells to frequently fail to cast.

1.description: [Pending restart] Mass Dispel now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 60 sec.

0.description:
[Season 7]: Call to Arms battleground quests are now a shared quest because you could only complete 1 per day anyways. This no longer leaves you guessing to which daily you should choose before entering a random battleground. 

You may now also pick up Call to Arms: Battleground at level 10.

Leveling Battleground caches will now give you Regular gear instead of bloodforged gear. Since PvP Power does not work until end-game and then you can use those items to jump into dungeons at end-game or bloody them if you wish!
Added fancy icons to Dungeon and Battleground Caches for the stat selection.
BGs should now grant experience when they end even when you are the max level in that bracket.
Lowered the buyback cost of Skillcards from Ameer the Recovery npc by 50%.
Implemented some performance improvements.
Added a mount trainer to Stormwind in Old Town.
Treasure Keeper companion can now be used in start zones without being rested.
Increased the duration of Corpserunner in dungeons to 45 seconds.

1.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Stoneform could not be used while you were on the global cooldown. [Requires Launcher update]

7.description: [Pending restart] Scorch (Scorched Earth) now deals 15% reduced damage to players, changed from 5%.
[Pending restart] Searing Pain (Perilous Pain) now deals 5% reduced damage to players. It previously did 5% increased damage to players.
[Pending restart] Scorched Earth no longer has any movement speed penalty while casting.
[Pending restart] Perilous Pain no longer has any movement speed penalty while casting.

0.description:
[Area-52] Soon coming to Season 7: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin, Warsong Gulch, Twin Peaks, etc are now one globalized quest for winning a battleground since you could only complete one quest per day anyways.

This change also allows you to queue for the specific Call to Arms for that day or queue for Random Battlegrounds while still completing your daily battleground quest.
Fixed an issue where the Conqueror's Headguard had the critical strike rating flipped in Normal / Ascended.
Overhauled Battleground Caches to let you choose your stat type instead of giving you 6 pairs of blue boots.
Added Ammunition and Stablemaster filters to minimap filtering
[Requires Launcher Update] You can now scale and move the Loss of Control popup by clicking on [Esc > Interface > Lose Control > Move Window]
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed missing textures on the Lose Control popup
[Requires Launcher Update] Added a Loss of Control popup when affected by CC spells. This can be configured or disabled entirely in [Esc > Interface > Lose Control]
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where items lost their flavor text
[Area-52] Bloodforged Vestments of the Aldor no longer has spell penetration as a stat and has substituted in hit or critical strike rating.
[Area-52] Bloodforged Mantle of the Mind Flayer no longer has spell penetration as a stat and has substituted in hit or critical strike rating.
[Area-52] Bloodforged Arcane Netherband no longer has spell penetration as a stat and has substituted in hit or critical strike rating.
